title: China's memory buildout could boost Korean suppliers as local rivals gain ground
html:
China's memory chip expansion could bring new orders to South Korean semiconductor equipment and materials suppliers, even as Chinese manufacturers gain ground in their home market.

Zheng Gang discusses opportunities and challenges for Korean semiconductor suppliers in China. Credit: Daniel Chiang
summary: China's memory chip expansion could bring new orders to South Korean semiconductor equipment and materials suppliers, even as Chinese manufacturers gain ground in their home market.
